Exactly min_samples outcomes are enough to decide; the boundary is inclusive

The pre-existing engine regression suite still passes on the integrated tree
The shipped linksvc service still passes its own acceptance harness
The fleet can still deploy a running system and probe it: ready under 10s, p50 under 50ms
